summary: Audited all BlackroseJournal screens (today, explore, entries, insights, settings, chat, entry-detail, entry-reflection, goals, personas new/generate/advanced/[id], memory-graph, streak-view, streak-haiku, rewards, happiness-recipe, saved-insights, suggestions, drafts, ask-rosebud, intentions chat/select/detail/edit, checkin-detail, and the 4 auth screens) plus the loading primitives (Skeleton/SkeletonText/LoadingBar/LoadingStatus/TypingIndicator). The app's consistency handles async AI/streaming screens well: chat, intention-chat, entry-reflection, suggestions, ask-rosebud, narrative introduction all use TypingIndicator, and entry-detail, check-in-detail, intentions-edit, streak-haiku, insights, entries/history, explore, and memory-graph all render shimmer skeletons or a LoadingStatus overlay. Empty states are strongest in entries (HistoryEmpty), explore/memory (MemoryEmpty), memory-graph (EmptyState), insights, and intentions. Today and Goals have reasonable inline empty states. The weakest areas are: (1) async screens that render BEFORE data and flash empty/blank — today, goals, saved-insights, drafts, happiness-recipe, rewards; (2) a few serious infinite-spinner bugs where loading and not-found share one guard (intentions/detail `isLoading || !intention`, persona/[id] `!values`, persona/generate on AI failure with no error handling); (3) genuinely MISSING states — saved-insights and drafts have no empty state (flat blank lists), entry-detail has no not-found empty state, and error handling is absent on today, drafts, memory-graph, insights, and continue-mode chat. Auth screens are well-formed (inline status banners, submitting button labels). Primary recommendation: adopt one shared 'not found / error + retry' pattern (the LoadingStatus and EmptyState primitives already exist and are underused), gate Today/Goals behind a skeleton using the hooks' isLoading flags, and add empty states to saved-insights and drafts. Full findings written to STATE_AUDIT.json.
